title: Mersh Kashmir
description: A modern e-commerce catalog for authentic Kashmiri products, showcasing wearables, shawls, dry fruits, saffron, and handcrafted goods through a streamlined shopping experience.
challenge: Create a lightweight online storefront that could showcase authentic Kashmiri products, organize an expanding catalog without a traditional database, and provide a simple ordering experience through WhatsApp rather than a full e-commerce checkout.
solution: Built a static HTML, Tailwind CSS, and vanilla JavaScript storefront featuring category-based browsing, product detail modals, cart and wishlist functionality, WhatsApp-powered checkout, PDF order receipt generation, and a Python automation script that rebuilds the catalog by scanning the products directory.
results: Product gallery and detail modal experience built
SEO and social sharing metadata included
